name: Objects of Obsession
thesis: Treat Raygen’s printers as sculptural objects in a stark fashion editorial, with enormous name typography and unapologetic machine crops.
interaction: An angled SERV0 makes a single sweeping entrance; the Remove panels control crossfades to its aligned internal assembly, while editorial anchor links lead through DAVID and Hack Club.
why: The unusual silhouettes, turquoise hardware, and actual constructions supply the character; Raygen’s name, machines, and daily dedication to Hack Club take the space normally given to a portfolio pitch.
